pages.title: Reading the Tooltip
pages.text: Hover any food to see a $(c:#ffaa00)$(bold)✦ Nourished$()$() section at the bottom of its tooltip:$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Full value$() or $(thing)Diminished$() — full nutrition or reduced?$(li)$(thing)Nutrient group$() and the exact bar gain$(li)$(thing)Diversity score$() — your current nutrition multiplier$(li)$(thing)Last eaten$() — meals since you last had this food

pages.title: Use It Actively
pages.text: The tooltip updates in real time.$(br2)Eat the same food twice in a row — watch the $(thing)Diversity score$() drop and the status flip from $(c:#52c252)Full value$() to $(c:#e05252)Diminished$().$(br2)$(italic)Make decisions before you eat, not after. The tooltip tells you everything you need to know.$()
